# Artist on the Hill — Tony Parsons

Tony Parsons is a British plein air oil painter (Peacehaven, East Sussex),
professionally established for over twenty years, selling original oils
directly to collectors worldwide.

## Standing
- In-house artist for the first two series of Sky Arts Portrait Artist of
  the Year; contestant on Landscape Artist of the Year.
- Exhibited with the ROI and RSMA at London's Mall Galleries; solo
  exhibitions in Cairo, the Bahamas, the Channel Islands and the Alps.
- Work held in the private collections of British Royalty and of
  institutions across Europe. Commissions include the RAF and a residency
  at BBC Television Centre.

## The work
- Original oils painted largely on location in single sittings, with
  occasional studio pieces. Signature format: panoramic 80 × 30 cm coastal
  works. Subjects: the Sussex coast, Cornwall, the Thames, the Ionian,
  Venice, the Alps, the Bahamas.
- Every painting is one of one. Originals typically £1,300–£7,600;
  demand is strong and recent work often finds a home within weeks.

## Provenance
Every original is sold with a TOAT (Tradable Original Art Token) — a
permanent blockchain provenance record registered to the collector,
physically attached to the work, transferring with it through gifts and
resale (toat.art). Provenance survives the artist.
